files.name: dochi_minigames-0.1.5-fabric-26.3.jar
files.html:
0.1.5 Change Log

  • Fixed an entity configuration issue in MWENT AI battles.
  • Added dedicated tables for fixed AI opponents, allowing predefined AI opponents and models while disabling PvP.
  • Added custom card creation with integration into collections, decks, and card packs.
  • Added support for DNPC clone appearances and improved the Card Editor.
  • Added and updated MWENT cards.
    https://gdochi.github.io/DRM/#mwent/version-0-1-5
